title: consolida tomentosa subsp. oligantha
intro: Consolida tomentosa subsp. oligantha, commonly known as the small-flowered larkspur, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the borage family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and antiviral effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Consolida tomentosa subsp. oligantha include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
